Answer: B
Reason: The imaging demonstrates a hypoplastic right lung with the characteristic scimitar vein (anomalous pulmonary venous return) and significant volume loss, which pulls the mediastinum to the right (dextroposition). This is consistent with right lung hypoplasia/aplasia associated with Scimitar syndrome, rather than effusion, mass, or left-sided pathology.
